contentText: Nearly half of Americans don’t know that processed meat increases colorectal cancer risk, according to a new poll. But once they learn the connection, most support warning labels—suggesting people want clearer information. Experts warn that awareness is lagging even among healthcare providers. The good news: diets rich in plant foods and fiber, along with healthy habits, can dramatically lower risk.
